vb_textbox.text: The time to allow to click the gnome and then basket is pretty quick so be alert especially as the latter part of the game you can feel a bit drowsy. I found the gnomes with taller brown and purple hats provided the higher number of mushrooms but when the number dropped I found lower, I changed to other gnomes for 2 or 3 goes and then back to to the gnomes with taller brown and purple hats.
